plugins.name: markdown-kanban
plugins.description: A three-file Markdown kanban (backlog / doing / done) that lives in your repo and is versioned with your work, with phases, ticket splitting with integration checks, storm tickets for unclear work, a start ritual with an editable approval policy, context-saving reading rules, and hygiene rules that keep the board honest.
